text: Hi I rang the London consulate and explained that we were getting married in November and I wanted to return as a toshav hozer. Wife not Jewish. I left Israel in 1988. No family there, no contacts. Nothing. I received this in reply.  "Are there any rabbis or senior Jewish communal figures who can attest to your relationship?" This is just weird. Why would I be in contact with any rabbis or senior Jewish figures if I'm marrying out? Any ideas on how to proceed? Thanks
